items.context: Carlos changed the subject and the two talked for another two hours.
items.reason: In this context 'changed the subject' clearly refers to changing the topic of conversation. While Spanish 'sujeto' commonly means 'person/individual,' the verb 'changed the' makes the topic meaning obvious. A Spanish speaker would not be confused here.
